objective_value: <float> Total expected profit, equal to expected sales revenue minus total manufacturing cost.

solution.x: <dict, key: '{product_id}_{facility_id}'> Quantity of raw materials (in finished-goods units) allocated to each product at each facility.
solution.y: <dict, key: '{product_id}_{facility_id}_{level_id}'> Whether the given production level is selected for each product at each facility (1 = selected, 0 = not selected).
solution.delta: <dict, key: '{product_id}_{distribution_id}'> Whether the given joint yield-and-demand distribution is selected for each product (1 = selected, 0 = not selected).
solution.z: <dict, key: '{product_id}_{distribution_id}_{scenario_id}'> Available inventory of each product in each scenario of each distribution.
solution.w: <dict, key: '{product_id}_{distribution_id}_{scenario_id}'> Amount of each product sold at full price in each scenario of each distribution.
solution.o: <dict, key: '{product_id}_{distribution_id}_{scenario_id}'> Amount of each product sold at discounted price (excess inventory) in each scenario of each distribution.
